sections.overview: This Asian hawkmoth ranges from western Asia through the Oriental tropics to Sundaland and the Lesser Sunda Islands.
sections.identification: Its forewing’s postmedial line is punctate on the veins, while the thorax and upper abdomen lack bands in the Borneo account’s description.
sections.habitat: The Borneo account calls it infrequent and notes records from lowlands as well as one high-elevation locality.
sections.diet: The Borneo species account records Cissus as a larval host plant.
sections.behavior: The species accounts used here do not describe a distinctive adult behavior pattern.
sections.reproduction: The Borneo account describes larval stages but does not detail the complete reproductive cycle.
sections.ecology: It is a congener of Theretra alecto; see that profile for its broader recorded host-plant list.
sections.conservation: The species accounts consulted do not provide a global conservation category or population trend.
